channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: 'This is an incredible vote of confidence in our product' - seaweed innovator smashes crowdfunding target
item.description: A Welsh seaweed-based biodegradable membrane innovator has smashed its £50,000 crowdfunding target, raising £350,000 which will help advance production from lab-scale innovation to industrial manufacturing trials.

item.title: Sky-House Co submits plans for latest Sheffield city centre development
item.description: Housebuilder Sky-House Co has lodged plans for a new development in Sheffield city centre.

item.title: Work underway to redevelop former pub - proposed industrial scheme would bring "significant economic and social benefits"
item.description: Work has started on the redevelopment of a derelict former inn in West Yorkshire to create a new industrial development.

item.title: Leeds office development reaches full occupancy - follows refurbishment by Allenby Commercial
item.description: A Leeds office development is now fully occupied following completion of refurbishment work.

item.title: Powerleague to launch padel courts at Stoke-on-Trent venue
item.description: Powerleague, an operator of small-sided football venues, is set to introduce padel courts at its Stoke Trentham Lakes club following an £815,000 investment. The move forms part of its wider national padel expansion.

item.title: Advanced manufacturer targets increased exports after securing seven-figure funding
item.description: A Stoke-on-Trent-based advanced manufacturer is expanding its production capabilities after receiving a seven-figure funding package from HSBC UK with a view to increasing exports.

item.title: New managing director at Ornua Foods UK & Europe
item.description: Ornua Foods UK & Europe, one of the country's largest suppliers of retail packed cheese, has named its new managing director.

item.title: Former Pilgrim's UK factory in Coalville hits the market with £2.2m guide price
item.description: The former Pilgrim's UK manufacturing site in Coalville has been brought to market by Bond Wolfe with a guide price of £2.2m.

item.title: Law firm offers support to staff affected by Wilsons Solicitors closure - part of PM Law Group
item.description: A Pudsey law firm is offering support to solicitors and legal professionals impacted by the sudden closure of Wilsons Solicitors, part of the PM Law Group.

item.title: Portsmouth lodges City of Culture bid as new apprenticeship bus arrives
item.description: Portsmouth has submitted its bid to become UK City of Culture 2029, setting out a vision that places young people at the heart of the city's future.
